subject: How to include some (interactive) numbers in bold into a paragraph

messages.author: 94f212a79a30c07a
messages.subject: How to include some (interactive) numbers in bold into a paragraph
parts:
Dear all,

Into the Server.R file I perform an interactive paragraph using the following syntax:

  output$text1 <- renderText({
     paste("Accepting an alpha risk of ", input$alpha, " and a beta risk of ",input$beta," in a two-sided test, ",num1()," subjects are necessary in first group and ",num2()," in the second to recognize as statistically significant a difference greater than or equal to ",input$dif," units.", sep="")
  })


This is fine, but I would like to highlight the "interactive" numbers included in the paragraph in bold. I.e. I would like to display in bold "input$alpha", input$beta", "num1()" and "num2()".

Is it possible??

Thank you!

Marc

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to include some (interactive) numbers in bold into a paragraph
parts:
You could change your textOutput to a uiOutput and do this:

output$text1 <- renderUI({
  tagList(
" and a beta risk of ",

tags$strong(input$beta),
    " in a two-sided test, ",
    # etc...
  )
})
